always_key.definition: KEY with the most frequent training key on every frame

card_blind.definition: oracle action type; for KEY, the most frequent training continuation of the keys already typed into the clicked control; every click wrong. Uses privileged form state, never the request card, so it has no closed-loop rollout

constant_click.definition: CLICK on the most frequent training click cell on every frame

lookup_table.definition: frame digest -> oracle action, built on the test demonstrations

oracle.definition: the scripted oracle that produced the demonstrations
